scope: Source and UX review, prior native screenshots, current unit/browser checks and synthetic failure reproductions; no production database writes or private user media access.
priorities: Protect device-only clips and metadata during restore
Make confirmed online saves durable before deleting the phone file
Then simplify player/onboarding and scale large libraries

naming.assessment: Cue expresses a practice prompt in English. Que is generally read keh in Spanish and may need pronunciation/spelling reinforcement. This is a naming recommendation, not a trademark or store-availability search.
naming.migration: A display-name change can preserve the installed package, signing certificate, OAuth registration and existing local data; do not rename internal identifiers merely for branding.
naming.decision: Owner chose Keep BailaCue; no display-name, package, OAuth or database renaming.

icon: Modern geometric dancing-partners mark; original opaque master selected for icon, adaptive foreground, splash, favicon and in-app mark. No unsuccessful transparent drafts are shipped.

findings.title: Cloud restore can hide local-only clips
findings.impact: Restoring an older cloud snapshot replaces the entire video list. A local-only clip absent from that snapshot disappears from the library even though its phone file remains. No merge preview or undo is offered.
findings.recommendation: Keep local-only entries or archive them, show a restore preview and create a recoverable local backup before replacing metadata.
findings.verification: Reproduced with the real restoreSnapshot function and synthetic metadata: one local entry became zero.

findings.title: A cleanup failure can prevent sign-out
findings.impact: Sign-out is reached only after reminders, file deletions, provider disconnects and library removal. A filesystem/provider error aborts cleanup before clearing the app session.
findings.recommendation: Make session teardown unconditional, track cleanup failures separately and retry leftover file removal. Explicitly identify unsynced/local-only material before destructive account cleanup.
findings.verification: Injected a filesystem failure into the actual cleanup function; account.logout was never reached. No real account or file was deleted.

findings.title: Online-only cleanup runs before durable metadata commit
findings.impact: The provider has the completed video, but React state updates are persisted later through a queued effect. A force-stop or storage write failure after local file deletion can leave stale local references or lose recent metadata. This does not mean the confirmed cloud MP4 is deleted.
findings.recommendation: Persist a confirmed-upload receipt and the new library entry before removing the local file. Make cleanup a recoverable transaction with a journal.
findings.verification: Ordering confirmed in source. The force-stop/storage-failure scenario has not been reproduced on a physical phone.

findings.title: Snapshots lack structural runtime validation
findings.impact: Server validation checks object size and forbidden keys, but an incomplete/version-incompatible object can be saved. Restore assumes arrays exist and can throw.
findings.recommendation: Validate snapshots against a versioned runtime schema on both sides; reject malformed payloads before changing the device library and retain a last-known-good copy.
findings.verification: The real restoreSnapshot({version:1}, local) threw a missing-map error. Production was not queried or modified.

findings.title: Expired authentication is treated like revoked file permission
findings.impact: Provider reauth errors enter the same download-deletion path as missing/restricted files. A temporary login problem can remove a useful offline download.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish expired sign-in from confirmed permission revocation. Request reconnect without deleting the file solely because of token expiry; keep explicit provider restriction handling.

findings.title: Large libraries render every card and scans repeatedly search arrays
findings.impact: The library uses ScrollView with map, and reconciliation repeatedly uses findIndex. Work grows with the full library rather than visible items.
findings.recommendation: Use a virtualized list, indexed maps for provider identities, memoized search and bounded thumbnail caches. Benchmark 100, 1000 and 10000 videos before setting performance claims.
findings.verification: Source-level scaling finding; no latency or memory benchmark was run.

findings.title: Online videos miss useful thumbnail previews
findings.impact: Provider thumbnails are available in mapped metadata but not assigned when a new remote library video is created. Many online cards show the generic play placeholder.
findings.recommendation: Fetch/cache authenticated thumbnails securely, preserve placeholders on failure and avoid persisting tokens or expiring media links.

findings.title: Provider registration and reconnect flows need a simpler user journey
findings.impact: The app still requires one-time app-level OAuth registration and users can encounter app-key/setup terminology. Multiple Google connections also require careful account switching: token lookup explicitly refuses the wrong current Google user.
findings.recommendation: Finish app-owner registration, guide users through connect, select Salsa/Bachata folders and upload permission in one flow, and show the account identity on every reconnect. Test real consent and expiry with both folders.
findings.verification: Source review and existing mocked tests only; real Google/Dropbox transfers remain unverified here.

findings.title: Player, trim, storage and notes compete in one long page
findings.impact: Common playback actions and less frequent settings share the same scrolling surface. Editing or adding notes can push the video out of view.
findings.recommendation: Keep a compact player/control dock visible and organize Practice, Trim and Notes into focused panels. Use a bottom sheet for storage/destination selection rather than repeated tall cards.

findings.title: Ratings should lead and Salsa/Bachata need separate daily slots
findings.impact: The previous score allowed label/feedback bonuses to outweigh star ratings, and a single total count did not guarantee one video of each style.
findings.recommendation: Use rating-first ranking within each style, independent cooldown fallback, a minimum rating, explicit refresh and empty slots when no eligible video exists.
findings.status: implemented in 0.2.6 source; release validation pending
findings.verification: Ten new unit cases and a browser journey cover rating priority, one-per-style, thresholds, cooldown, persistence and explicit refresh.

findings.title: Unfinished imports need recovery and cleanup
findings.impact: A picked/recorded video is retained in owned storage before its metadata is saved. An interrupted import can leave an unreferenced file, and there is no startup recovery journal.
findings.recommendation: Persist import drafts and recover or remove abandoned owned files after a safe grace period. Include exports and partial transfers in the same storage manager.

findings.title: Preference labels use a different input model
findings.impact: Import, folder and video labels have a searchable picker, while favorite labels use comma-separated text. Artist names containing commas are awkward and suggestions are inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the existing label picker for preferences and offer searchable artist/type filters in Library.

findings.title: Weekday labels and large-text layouts need device review
findings.impact: Weekday chips expose repeated S/T letters without full weekday accessibility names. Several horizontal rows depend on compact text. A physical TalkBack/Dynamic Type review has not been done.
findings.recommendation: Give weekdays full accessible names, test large system text/landscape and announce upload/export state changes. Test all critical controls with TalkBack and VoiceOver.
findings.verification: Weekday naming confirmed in source; screen-reader and large-text device outcomes are not claimed.

findings.title: Active sessions are not recovered after process termination
findings.impact: Running state and elapsed time live in component memory. Delayed timer callbacks can also add more than the intended focus interval.
findings.recommendation: Persist an active-session record, cap elapsed time at its deadline and offer resume/discard after interruption. Add interruption/clock-change cases.

findings.title: App-switcher and screenshot privacy need explicit validation
findings.impact: The lock resets on background only. Inactive transitions and app-switcher snapshots require platform-specific checking; current tests do not demonstrate their protection.
findings.recommendation: Review inactive-state masking and platform snapshot protection, with a clear user setting and physical-device validation.
findings.verification: Validation gap, not a demonstrated privacy leak.

findings.title: Dependency audit requires SDK-compatible triage
findings.impact: npm audit --omit=dev reported 29 affected dependency entries (20 high, 9 moderate) linked to three underlying advisories. Build-tool dependencies are included by the package tree; this is not evidence of 29 exploitable mobile-app flaws.
findings.recommendation: Trace each advisory to shipped/runtime use versus tooling, update within Expo SDK compatibility, and review a native dependency inventory. Do not apply the suggested force downgrade to old Expo/React Native majors.
findings.verification: Actual npm audit and dependency-path inspection. No exploit was attempted.

checks.baseline: Fresh TypeScript, lint and all 100 existing tests passed before the new feature work.
checks.newFeature: 110 tests /11 suites, five Chromium journeys, type/lint and web export passed after final modern-icon integration. Build9 native acceptance pending.
checks.nativeBaseline: Published build8 passed ten Google ARTEMIS controller checks; that result is not a claim that the new build has been tested.

unverified: Real Drive/Dropbox consent, upload, expiry and interrupted large-file transfers
Physical camera, notifications, screen readers and app-switcher privacy
